shows.name: That'll Be The Day: A Tribute to Buddy Holly
shows.info: In THAT'LL BE THE DAY, Todd Meredith and The Rave-Ons will take you on a musical journey starting with Buddy's early recordings through his breakout hits. Audience members will be treated to humorous banter and music history trivia inspired by this influential group. This performance gives a fresh take on the catalog of Buddy Holly & The Crickets, featuring all the band's hits as well as some lesser known gems. Buddy is a true music pioneer and is considered by many to be the Father of Rock & Roll. Don't miss this exceptional tribute!
